historical_result_policy: All earlier outputs remain immutable and retain their recorded protocol and solver limit. V8 governs new executions only; diagnostic and confirmatory outputs must be identified separately and must not be silently pooled.
change_reason: increase the Gurobi time allowance from 60 to 300 seconds per optimization stage so difficult real-time, scaling and stochastic instances have more opportunity to prove or improve their incumbent solution
make the full no-AI trigger stateful across messages from the same event so a later confirmation can reuse the assets named in the earlier public maintenance message
apply the same evidence-change gate to the Agent and full no-AI triggers so persistent evidence does not create trigger chattering
leave the optimizer formulation, Agent prompts, hidden truth, cases, settlement and revenue-retention policy unchanged
make the requested limit part of the frozen protocol and reject executions whose command-line limit does not match it

design.analysis: descriptive difference in repeated-episode means within each case-mode cell; operational feasibility is reported before economic outcomes

components.trigger: frozen stateful text rule over the same public notice sequence, with same-event coreference and the shared evidence-change gate
components.evaluator: hard feasibility and bound checks only

contrasts.name: llm_trigger_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace only the LLM Trigger interpreter with the frozen text parser.

contrasts.name: llm_pricing_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace only LLM pricing with the deterministic price-zone heuristic under the same 50% baseline-revenue retention policy.

contrasts.name: llm_evaluator_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Remove only the LLM evaluator while retaining solver, feasibility and method-independent baseline-revenue retention guards.

contrasts.name: agentic_stack_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace the entire agentic layer with the matched rule-based loop; optimizer, inputs, disturbances and settlement are unchanged.

controls.causal_interval_settlement: settle interval t before the decision and optimize t+1 through 48

altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.baseline_source: frozen day_ahead_summary.aggregator_revenue for the altruistic mode
altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.full_day_rule: projected full-day aggregator revenue must be at least the frozen floor
altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.remaining_rule: remaining revenue required equals max(0, frozen full-day floor minus realized settled-prefix revenue)

controls.candidate_selection: operational priority first; for altruistic candidates require the 50% baseline-revenue retention floor before comparing projected full-day PTO cost
controls.solver_time_limit_scope: per optimization stage or standalone solve, not a whole-episode wall-clock cap

outcomes.altruistic_score: among runs meeting the 50% baseline-revenue retention floor, use the negative of realized full-day PTO cost so that higher is better
